title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
text:
Lily loves nursery rhymes. Her favorite one is Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star. She sings it every night before bed. The song talks about a small star in the sky.

One night, Lily sings the song to her little brother. He smiles and claps his hands. Then he falls asleep. Lily is happy because her brother likes the song.

questions.text: What is Lily's favorite nursery rhyme?
What does Lily's brother do after he hears the song?
options: He smiles and claps his hands

questions.text: When does Lily usually sing her favorite song?
Why is Lily happy at the end of the story?

vocabulary.definition: hits your hands together to show that you like something
uses your voice to make music or a song

paragraph_translations: A Lily le encantan las canciones infantiles. Su favorita es Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star. Ella la canta todas las noches antes de dormir. La canción habla de una estrella pequeña en el cielo.
Una noche, Lily le canta la canción a su hermanito. Él sonríe y aplaude. Luego se queda dormido. Lily está feliz porque a su hermanito le gusta la canción.
